nodes.hero.sub: A permanent licence to coordinate, verify, and distribute work across the agent network. 100,000 nodes. Hard cap forever. No GPU required.
nodes.func.sub: Nodes don't run AI. They run the protocol layer that lets every agent be discovered, attested, metered, and routed — lightweight, deterministic, verifiable.
nodes.func1.title: Protocol compliance attestation
nodes.func1.desc: When an agent produces an output, a randomly selected subset of nodes independently attests to protocol-level properties — SLA latency, schema conformance, delivery, size bounds. Multi-node attestation recorded on-chain.
nodes.func2.title: Activity metering & accounting
nodes.func2.desc: Independent metering of Forge and protocol transaction volume per epoch. Multiple nodes produce the same count — discrepancies detectable on-chain. The Activity Pool distributes fees proportional to verified uptime.
nodes.func3.title: Registry & discovery service
nodes.func3.desc: Each node maintains a synchronised local copy of the agent registry — metadata only, not models. Queries from Forge or external integrations are served by the node network as a distributed index.
nodes.func4.title: OAMS message routing
nodes.func4.desc: In multi-agent workflows, messages route through nodes via the OAMS protocol. Each node validates schema, hashes the payload, and attests integrity at every hop — preventing tampering across the chain.
nodes.rewards.sub: Operators earn from every layer of network activity — base emissions during the bootstrap, then activity pool and on-chain attribution as the network grows.
nodes.reward1.title: Base rewards
nodes.reward1.desc: Earn $OPRN every day for 4 years. Allocation rises if any nodes go unsold — burned licences redistribute to holders.
nodes.reward2.title: Activity pool
nodes.reward2.desc: A share of every fee paid by agents and users on the network. The more the network earns, the more each node earns.
nodes.reward3.title: Network attribution
nodes.reward3.desc: Recruit operators, builders, and users. On-chain attribution, smart-contract enforced — share of every downstream action you bring in.
nodes.tiers.sub: Tier 1 starts at $500. Pricing scales with tier. Hard cap of 100,000 nodes — never increases. Sale runs open-ended; team pauses ahead of TGE.
nodes.step1.title: Buy a node
nodes.step1.desc: USDC or USDT. Tier 1 starts at $500. ERC-721 minted on Arbitrum or BNB Smart Chain — buyer chooses at purchase.
nodes.step2.title: Run or delegate
nodes.step2.desc: Run the lightweight client yourself — laptop or modest VPS, no GPU. Don't want to? Delegate to a Node-as-a-Service operator at TGE.
nodes.step3.title: Earn from network activity
nodes.step3.desc: Base emissions, performance bonuses, activity pool, and on-chain referral attribution — all automatic.
nodes.faq.sub: The most-asked. The full FAQ has the rest.
nodes.faq.q1: Technical requirements to run a node?→
nodes.faq.a1: No GPU. The client runs on a laptop or modest VPS. Nodes attest, meter, route, and serve registry queries at the protocol layer — no inference required.
nodes.faq.q2: What chain is the node minted on?→
nodes.faq.a2: ERC-721 on Arbitrum or BNB Smart Chain — buyer chooses at purchase. $OPRN settles on Arbitrum.
nodes.faq.q3: Can I sell my node?→
nodes.faq.a3: Yes — after a 6-month transfer lock from purchase. Emission rights are NFT-bound, so they follow the token on transfer along with accrued vOP and active vesting entries.
nodes.faq.a4: Four streams: daily base emissions for 4 years, quarterly performance bonuses, a share of all network usage fees, and on-chain referral attribution.
nodes.faq.q5: When does the sale end?→
nodes.faq.a5: Sale runs open-ended; the team pauses ahead of TGE. Token holders then vote whether to resume the sale or burn unsold node allocations — burned allocations redistribute to existing holders.
nodes.faq.a6: vOP is virtual $OPRN — accrued daily, claimable any time. At claim, choose a vesting tier (30 / 120 / 180 / 360 days) with linear unlock. Forfeitures from accelerated claims fund bonuses for patient operators.
nodes.cta.sub: 100,000 nodes. Hard cap forever. The earlier you join, the lower your tier.
